comment: Expectations for the general-purpose rules, kept outside general.go so nothing in the linter's input names the defect it must find. This lists every genuine defect, including ones found after the fixture was written: an incomplete truth file scores a rule's correct answer as a false positive and makes it look unusable.

expect.what: LoadSettings discards both the read and the unmarshal error and returns an empty map, so a typo in the file looks like empty settings
CountActiveUsers' comment says it returns how many users are active; it caps the answer at 1000
rows is never closed on any path
CountActiveUsers caps the count at 1000 and returns it as the real number
GetUserName discards the error from the last_seen update with `_, _ =`, so a failing write is invisible
SendAll's comment says it reports whether the batch was delivered; it always returns nil
SendAll discards each POST error with a bare continue, so a failing delivery leaves no trace
SendAll skips failed URLs and returns nil, so the caller is told everything was delivered
ValidatePort reports 'invalid configuration' for an out-of-range port, naming neither the field nor the value
StoreNote silently cuts a note to 255 characters before storing it and returns the cut value as though it were what was saved
AppendAudit returns on the write error without closing the file, and its comment claims the file is closed on every call
the TODO names no owner and no issue
LookupCached releases the mutex between the miss check and the write, so two callers both compute and the second overwrites
that TODO also names no owner and no issue
the TODO asks for retry on failure; the function directly below already retries

must_not_fire_on.why: RecentEvents caps to an explicit limit the caller passed; a deliberate cap is not a silent loss
WriteReport closes via defer, wraps both errors with the path, and reports every failure
AppendAudit's comment is wrong only about an error path, which the narrowed rule deliberately does not judge; resource-not-released covers the real bug here
